def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(v):
        # Split by '+' to separate build metadata
        base, _, build = v.partition('+')
        
        # Split by '-' to separate pre-release
        core, _, pre = base.partition('-')
        
        # Parse MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        parts = core.split('.')
        major, minor, patch = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        pre_identifiers = []
        if pre:
            pre_identifiers = pre.split('.')
        
        # Convert pre-release identifiers to comparable format
        pre_comparable = []
        for identifier in pre_identifiers:
            if identifier.isdigit():
                pre_comparable.append((0, int(identifier)))
            else:
                pre_comparable.append((1, identifier))
        
        return (major, minor, patch, pre_comparable)
    
    # Create list of (parsed_version, original_index, original_version)
    indexed_versions = [
        (parse_version(v), i, v)
        for i, v in enumerate(versions)
    ]
    
    # Sort by parsed version, then by original index for stability
    # A version with pre-release (non-empty pre_comparable) should sort before
    # the same version without pre-release (empty pre_comparable)
    indexed_versions.sort(key=lambda x: (
        x[0][:3],  # MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH
        (len(x[0][3]) > 0, x[0][3])  # Has pre-release (False sorts first), then pre-identifiers
    ) + (x[1],) if len(x[0][3]) > 0 or True else (x[0][:3], (False, ()), x[1]))
    
    indexed_versions.sort(key=lambda x: (
        x[0][0],  # MAJOR
        x[0][1],  # MINOR
        x[0][2],  # PATCH
        len(x[0][3]) > 0,  # Has pre-release (False < True, so no pre-release sorts after)
        x[0][3],  # Pre-release identifiers
        x[1]  # Original index for stability
    ))
    
    return [v[2] for v in indexed_versions]
